definitions.explanation: Conversation that serves no productive purpose. Can be mildly negative (wasting time) or neutral (casual socializing), depending on context.

examples.japanese: {無駄話|むだばなし}はやめて⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Stop chatting and get to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{無駄話|むだばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was scolded by my boss for chitchatting with a colleague.

examples.japanese: ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無駄話|むだばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧もし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes it's nice to spend time relaxing and just chatting about nothing.

notes:
USAGE:
{無駄話|むだばなし} implies the conversation has no particular point or purpose. In work settings it is negative (time-wasting), but socially it can be neutral or even positive (enjoying casual conversation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無駄話|むだばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make idle talk)
- {無駄話|むだばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (to talk too much idly)
- {無駄話|むだばなし}はやめろ (stop the chitchat)

FORMS:
⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧ (futile, pointless) + ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (talk). The ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ becomes ば through rendaku.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{雑談|ざつだん}→雑談：06639_zatsudan⟧ (casual conversation) is more neutral and common. おしゃべり (chatting) is lighthearted. {無駄話|むだばなし} specifically emphasizes the lack of purpose.
